caption: The drawing depicts a single object: a sculpted horse’s head, rendered in shades of dark brown and gray. The sculpture is positioned centrally on an off-white or cream-colored background with no additional objects or elements present. The horse's head is detailed, showing its mane, ears, eyes, and nostrils, with the mane flowing down the neck. The bust rests on a decorative pedestal featuring angular edges and leaf-like carvings on its surface. The lighting and shadowing suggest volume and depth, and the sculpture appears to be made of stone or metal due to its textured appearance and muted colors. The overall composition is simple, with the object isolated in the center and ample negative space around it.
title: Hitching Post
